articles.title: Indian fallen soldiers of Great War honored in Istanbul
articles.summary: Indian soldiers who sacrificed their lives in World War I were solemnly commemorated in Istanbul, Turkey, at the Haidar Pasha Cemetery. The ceremony, held on India's Army Day, honored their bravery and service far from home. This event highlights the significant historical contributions of Indian forces on a global stage, a legacy crucial for aspiring defense personnel to appreciate.

articles.title: Train collision in Spain kills 21, injures dozens
articles.summary: Spain reeled from a high-speed train collision in Adamuz, southern Spain, early on January 19, 2026. The accident involved two high-speed trains, prompting a swift response from Red Cross members at the scene. This significant transport incident underscores the importance of stringent safety protocols in railway operations.
